name: agency-accessibility
description: Accessibility consulting agency: client audit and remediation delivery, stricter client-facing review thresholds, mapped onto the same real agents and connector families.
goals: Deliver a WCAG 2.2 audit report to every client on the agreed date.
Remediate client findings and re-verify each fix with evidence before handover.
Keep every client-facing document reviewed by a human before it is sent.
Convert completed audits into recurring accessibility retainers.

roles.title: Agency Director
roles.mission: Own client commitments, delivery capacity and the audit-to-retainer pipeline.

roles.title: Delivery Lead
roles.mission: Scope each client audit into tasks and guard report quality before handover.

roles.title: Agency Marketing Lead
roles.mission: Publish case studies and service pages only after delivery sign-off.

roles.title: Business Development Lead
roles.mission: Qualify audit requests and draft proposals that a human reviews before send.

roles.title: Client Success Manager
roles.mission: Run client check-ins and turn audit follow-ups into tracked support tickets.

roles.title: Remediation Engineer
roles.mission: Fix server-side accessibility defects in client stacks with tests on a branch.

roles.title: Accessibility Engineer
roles.mission: Fix markup, focus-order and contrast findings to WCAG 2.2 AA.

roles.title: Accessibility Auditor
roles.mission: Run manual and automated WCAG checks and record per-criterion evidence.

roles.title: Delivery Operations
roles.mission: Manage client staging environments and release windows under approval.

roles.title: Report Reviewer
roles.mission: Review client-facing reports and remediation diffs before they reach a client.

roles.title: Accessibility Knowledge Lead
roles.mission: Maintain the WCAG reference library and reusable audit templates.

roles.title: Resourcing Coordinator
roles.mission: Track specialist capacity and flag delivery bottlenecks early.

roles.title: Client Finance Analyst
roles.mission: Reconcile retainers, invoices and cost per engagement in the outcome ledger.

notes: Agency flavour of the lean pack: client-facing work needs a human review before anything leaves the building, so all three review thresholds are stricter than the lean-startup defaults.
